script_text: This week asks Aquarius to stop performing certainty and claim power. Early on, the Sun in your 10th House of Scorpio squares Jupiter in your 7th House of Leo, so career ambition tests partnership limits. Monday through Wednesday asks for patience, exposes hidden expectations, and warns against ultimatums in love. Mid-week, Venus stations direct in your 10th House and squares Pluto in your 1st House, turning attraction into a negotiation. By Thursday, your ruler Saturn conjunct Neptune in your 2nd House of Pisces makes money boundaries both dreamy and strict. Friday brings clarity through Mercury direct in your 10th House, and the weekend rewards honest promises. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury direct in the 10th House supports career. Saturday is your worst day because Venus square Pluto exposes control. Let your air element name the price and the feeling. Follow for daily updates.
